# Resume PDF Placeholder

Place your resume PDF file at this exact location:

**public/Pankaj_Nikam_Resume.pdf**

The website's "Download Resume" and "View Resume" buttons are already wired to this path. Once you add the actual PDF file here, both buttons will work automatically — no code changes needed.

To add the file:
1. Save your resume as a PDF named exactly: `Pankaj_Nikam_Resume.pdf`
2. Place it inside the `public/` folder of this project
3. The download and view buttons will immediately start working
